{{Top}}
'''Baleen''' were biological adaptations that were possessed by [[Ycaqt]]. Ycaqt scooped up more than twelve [[Liter/Legends|liters]] of [[Water/Legends|water]] at a time and used their baleen to filter [[Plankton/Legends|plankton]], their primary food source, out of the water. Ycaqt avoided using their mouths to defend themselves in order to prevent their baleen from being damaged.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
